notes.title: The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells will soon be discontinued!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,  [/p][p][/p][p]The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells will soon be made unavailable on the Steam store. 

If you'd like to try out The RPG before buying the main game, the demo will still be available, offering up to an hour of playtime.

[dynamiclink href="steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/3221750/The_RPG_Demo/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We've had several reports of players having issues with their saves from The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells when importing to the main game, mainly issues about balancing. It is also difficult to maintain the main game, the demo, and this version with constant updates as a solo developer. So, the decision had to be made to pull The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells from the Steam store to offer the best experience with The RPG.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429270/The_RPG/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The RPG is now available!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey everyone,

[b]The RPG is out right now! [/b]You can buy it with a 10% launch discount for the first week, running from August 7 to August 14.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429270/The_RPG/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]For more information about the content in the release version, you can click the button below to check out the previous announcement with a full list of content in the game.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2429270/view/498327923676152403?l=english" style="button"]Announcement with content list[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="nuHznIlVGfE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the game, leaving a review helps us out a ton. In addition to the reviews, you can also let us know your feedback on the [url="https://discord.com/invite/48fMKBdTEp"]Discord server[/url] or the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2429270/discussions/"]Steam Discussions forum[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]The RPG is also fully playable on the Steam Deck! [/b]You can continue playing on whichever device you'd like by having your save files sync to your PC and Steam Deck through Steam Cloud. If you have any suggestions for improvements or any other feedback specific to the Steam Deck you'd like us to know, please refer to the links above for feedback channels.[/p][p][/p][p]If you played [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361480/The_RPG_My_First_Dungeon_Smells/"]The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells[/url] before, you can directly import your save file to the full game. During save selection when starting a new game, you'll see a button to import your save if the game detects a save file from The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells. However, for the best experience, we recommend starting a new save.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Festivals[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We are also taking part in two amazing festivals: [b]Tiny Teams [/b]and [b]Debut Festival[/b]. Huge thanks to the Yogscast and GameDev.ist teams for organizing these events, and including us! You can click the buttons below to check out all the great games included in the festivals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44099477/0f7103c5af60427147676367f430a8299f2a03fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/423471/sale/tinyteams2025" style="button"]Tiny Teams 2025[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44099477/971ccb83baeea3981da1a9974448c918c45dbe37.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44730990/sale/debutfestival2025" style="button"]Debut Festival 2025[/url][/p]

notes.title: The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells is now available! Wishlist the full game!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells is out right now for everyone to [b]play for free![/b] Offering [b]hours of content[/b], in The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells, explore the island, clear levels in the dungeon, and complete quests [b]without any playtime limit.[/b]

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2361480/The_RPG_My_First_Dungeon_Smells/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

Please [b]wishlist the full game[/b] if you enjoy this introductory version, as wishlists help us gain visibility for our game and show us your interest!

steam://openurl/https://store.steampowered.com/app/2429270/The_RPG/?snr=1_5_1100__1100&utm_source=steamwidget

[u][b]Your saves from The RPG: My First Dungeon Smells will transfer over to the full game when it launches. So, play to your heart's content for free now and continue your journey when the full game releases![/b][/u]
